description: Held the book, and kept the court cut where the 26th had put it.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Entered as the Lady, and said the hem will not go down again.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Stopped the climb on the name, and left the rest alone.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Held under the note, and would not discuss the doublet.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Played the window at a run and kept his eyes on Nick.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked how funny the Nurse may be on Saturday, and was told Wednesday.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Read the fragment and did not mark the roll.
name: William Shakespeare
